title: Existence of the determinant-normalized dual Koszul comparison
statement: For a commutative ring A, ideal I, Koszul-regular sequence f generating I, there exists a determinant-normalized quasi-isomorphism from the dual Koszul complex to the normal determinant concentrated in degree r.

proof.text: Use the determinant pairing to identify dual exterior-power terms with complementary Koszul terms, then use Koszul regularity for exactness away from the top and reduction modulo I for the determinant cokernel.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_koszul_conormal_comparison
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I) :
    ∃ φ : koszulDualComplex A r f ⟶
        (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat A) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) r).obj
          (koszulNormalDeterminant A I r),
      IsKoszulConormalComparison A I r f hf φ ∧ QuasiIso φ
